title: Learning a few things about running SQLite
summary: Julia Evans shares practical lessons learned about running SQLite in production environments, covering real-world considerations like concurrency, backup strategies, and performance tuning that are often overlooked in documentation.
problem_solved: Provides practical guidance for developers who want to run SQLite reliably in production instead of just for local development.
why_valuable: SQLite is underestimated for production use, and this post offers real-world operational insights from someone who has deployed it at scale.
